title: Endless Survival Horror FPS zombie shooter I've been working on
author: Motta_ARG
selftext:
What’s up? Here’s a little game I’ve been working on and off for about two months. I built it using Three.js, Howler, and bitECS.

It’s obviously heavily inspired by CoD Zombies, but with a greater emphasis on survival horror, base building, setting up turrets, upgrading your weapons and fighting off different zombie types. I’d describe it as a mix between CoD Zombies and *The Last Stand* (the classic Flash game).

The sound effects and weapon models were taken from royalty-free websites like Pixabay and Sketchfab, and almost everything else was made with Claude Code (I mainly used Opus 4.8/5 since I’m on the Pro plan).

The textures were generated by going back and forth with ChatGPT (free tier), asking it to create PS1-style textures until I got results I was happy with.

The visual style I was aiming for was PS1-era graphics inspired by *Silent Hill* and the original *Resident Evil* games. The next thing I want to work on is creating PS1-style zombie models and animations because the current ones (wich where generated using three.js primitives) don't look very good, for doing this I want to experiment with Claude's Blender MCP to see if I can come up with something useful.

Hope you like it! Feedback is more than welcome!

comments.author: Silver-Chipmunk7744
comments.body: Looks cool.  Personally i'd prefer some sort of NPC ally instead of a tower but personal preference.

replies.author: Motta_ARG
replies.body: Hey thanks! I have definitely considered having friendly NPCs help you out but it would be harder to program them compared to the turret, also i like the strategy behind where to place the turrets so that is why i sticked with turrets instead of friendly NPCs
